description: Use when configuring delegated administration to allow non-system-admin users to manage specific user groups, reset passwords, assign permission sets, or administer custom objects. Covers the DelegateGroup metadata type (delegateGroups/*.delegateGroup-meta.xml), its roles / profiles / permissionSets / permissionSetGroups / groups / customObjects / loginAccess fields, delegate-group log-in-as, and the deploy and review path for them. NOT for creating, deactivating or licensing users yourself — use admin/user-management. NOT for auto-assigning permission sets from user attributes — use admin/user-access-policies.
inputs: Target org with existing role hierarchy and profiles defined
List of users who will act as delegated administrators
List of profiles the delegated admins are allowed to assign
List of permission sets (if any) the delegated admins are allowed to assign
Custom objects (if any) the delegated admins should be able to administer
name: delegated-administration
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide, `DelegateGroup` — *Fields* table — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf (grounds the eight fields and their exact semantics: `roles` as "the roles and subordinates for which delegated administrators of the group can create and edit users"; `profiles` / `permissionSets` / `permissionSetGroups` / `groups` as assignment menus scoped to "users in specified roles and all subordinate roles"; `customObjects` covering "nearly every aspect … including creating a custom tab" but not relationships or org-wide sharing defaults; `label` and `loginAccess` as required — SKILL.md § Core Concepts, gotchas #3, #4, #6, #7, #8, #11)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `DelegateGroup` — *Special Access Rules* — same PDF (grounds "Only users with the 'View Setup and Configuration' permission can be delegated administrators. As of Spring '20 and later, only users with 'View Setup' or 'Configuration' permission can access this object" — SKILL.md § Before Starting, gotcha #1, and the checker's `ViewSetup` report)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `DelegateGroup` — *File Suffix and Directory Location*, *Version*, *Declarative Metadata Sample Definition*, *Wildcard Support* — same PDF (grounds the `.delegateGroup` suffix and `delegateGroups` folder, API 36.0+, the sample XML reproduced verbatim, and `*` wildcard support — `references/metadata-examples.md`)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `SecuritySettings` — `canUsersGrantLoginAccess`, `enableAdminLoginAsAnyUser` — same PDF (grounds the org-level settings behind the guide's "depending on your organization settings, individual users must grant login access" caveat on `loginAccess` — gotcha #6)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `Profile` and `OrgPreferenceSettings.enableProfileFiltering` (API 50.0+) — same PDF (grounds that "set up delegated admins where looking up profiles is needed to identify assignable profiles" and "administer an org as a delegated admin to view and assign profiles of the delegated group" expose profile names despite Profile Filtering — gotcha #10)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `Role` / `RoleOrTerritory` — same PDF (grounds that a role's `fullName` "corresponds to Role Name in the user interface", so `roles` entries are role API names — `references/metadata-examples.md`)

Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf (searched for `DelegateGroup`, `DelegateGroupMember`, `DelegateGroupGrant`: **no delegate-group SObject is documented**, which is why this skill's verification path is a retrieve round-trip plus Setup rather than SOQL — `references/metadata-examples.md` § Verification, gotcha #2)
Salesforce Well-Architected Overview — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html (pillar framing for the Security / Operational Excellence tradeoffs above)

Salesforce Help: Set Up Delegated Administration — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.admin_delegate.htm (original grounding for the Setup click-path in `references/examples.md`; not re-fetchable — help.salesforce.com does not serve to tooling, so the Setup steps carry no PDF citation)
outputs: Configured Delegated Administrator group(s) in Setup
Delegated admin group members list with scoped access
Checklist confirming what delegated admins can and cannot do in the target org
